text:
Updated the permissions block in `opencode.jsonc` based on the documentation:

**Changes:**
- Removed the invalid `"default": "ask"` pattern (not supported)
- Used proper pattern-based configuration with explicit `"allow"`, `"ask"`, and `"deny"` values
- Added wildcard patterns for git commands (e.g., `"git diff *": "allow"`)
- Added explicit `"ask"` permissions for destructive operations (git push, git commit, rm, installs)
- Added `"deny"` for dangerous operations (terraform, kubectl delete)
- Set `"*": "allow"` as the default fallback to allow all other commands

This follows the OpenCode permissions pattern matching system properly.
